args.body: At the first due live checkpoint, use the existing assignment and authoritative deployment receipt to identify the exact release and cutoff. Reuse any existing verdict. For the invoice CSV experiment, recommend whether to retain or end the intake on the observed evidence and distinguish eligible inquiries, replies, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and Treasury-verified settlement. Mark release-level measures unknown wherever coverage is incomplete. Give ACQUISITION the evidence needed for the existing mission, without creating a parallel verdict. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. Use permitted aggregates and redacted receipts only.

description: The Contracts Finder run reported zero keyword matches across nine releases. That narrows this feed window and gives BUYER_ROUTE enough evidence to finish the decision by checking the actual buyer scope. The five unclassified feedback sources leave live demand unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The catalogue pilot still depends on the operator’s send-or-decline decision. A specific standalone buyer request would reopen the Contracts Finder route, and an attributable request or a redacted operator receipt would change the live experiment decisions.
